items.question: What is Chained Beasts?
items.answer: A one-to-four-player co-op gladiator roguelike by Featherweight Games. Fight in arenas, use chains and environmental hazards, and manage injuries between battles.

items.question: Can you play solo?
items.answer: Yes. The official Steam listing includes single-player as well as online and local co-op.

items.question: Which platforms are announced?
items.answer: Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch, with Game Pass for Xbox and Windows PC announced for launch.

items.question: Is this the official wiki?
items.answer: No. This is an independent fan resource. Featherweight Games owns the game and its artwork.
